scripts.css-compile: echo 'Compiling SCSS...' && sass --load-path=node_modules --style expanded --source-map --embed-sources --no-error-css scss/:css/ && echo 'SCSS compiled successfully!'
scripts.css-prefix: echo 'Running PostCSS...' && postcss -u postcss-inline-svg autoprefixer -r 'css/**/*.css' --no-map && echo 'PostCSS processing completed!'
scripts.build: echo 'Starting build process...' && npm-run-all --silent css-compile css-prefix && echo 'Build process completed successfully!'
